offers_products.reason: Sells jet engines, aircraft, spare parts and after-market engine parts, alongside leasing.

offers_services.reason: Engine leasing, financing, fleet management, consulting, Part 145 on-wing support and 24/7 AOG support for airlines.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are airlines, freight operators and MROs, not individuals or households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Leases engines to commercial airlines, cargo carriers and MROs.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is lease rent from engines on operating leases, with repeat airline customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Airline demand for engine leases and spare parts falls with air travel downturns, and fleets can be cut.

big_ticket.reason: Engines are mostly leased, often short-term, with recurring rent payments. Some engine and parts sales are large.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay mainly for leased engine assets and parts, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are commercial airlines and freight carriers, though some are small regional airlines.

asset_heavy.reason: Growth requires buying and owning a large portfolio of jet engines and aircraft to lease.

notes: Some customers, such as small regional airlines, are smaller enterprises.
